gandhabba.cp: masc. 1. a musician; a heavenly musician belonging to the demigods; 2. a being ready to take a new existence.
gandhabba.p: [Gamu+tabba] (pu) CL=8 Gandha+abba+a. Gandha+ava+a]   (1) Gandhabba deity (class of minstrel nat spirits inhabiting the Myin-mo(a mountain mentioned in the Buddhist Scripture)). (2)  who named Gandhabba. (3) performer (especially of dramatic art);  (A) Dancer. (B) Singer. (C) Harpist. (5) Singing. (6) Art book. (7) Horses. (8) Monkeys. (9) Creatures that will approach the womb.(Ti)  (10) should be reached/arrrived/attained. Gandhabbakāyika - see also. Gandhabbahattha, gandhabbahatthaka- see.
pn: Gandhabba. An attendant of King Eḷeyya and a follower of Uddaka Rāmaputta. AN.ii.180.
a: ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗ(ပု)
[ဂမု+တဗ္ဗ။
[gamu+tabba.

ဂန္ဓ+အဗ္ဗ+အ။ ဂန္ဓ+အဝ+အ] (၁)ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗနတ်။(၂)ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗမည်သောသူ။(၃)သဘင်အနုပညာသည်။(က)ကချေသည်။(ခ)အဆိုတော်။(ဂ)စောင်းသမား။(၎)(က)သီးချင်းသံ။(ခ)စောင်းသံ။(၅)သီဆိုခြင်း။(၆)အနုပညာကျမ်း။(၇)မြင်း။(၈)မျောက်။(၉)(အမိဝမ်းသို့)ကပ်ရောက် လတ္တံ့သော သတ္တဝါ။(တိ)(၁ဝ)ရောက်အပ်-ရောက်သင့်-ရောက်ထိုက်-သော။ ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗကာယိက-လည်းကြည့်။ ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗဟတ္ထ, ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗဟတ္ထက-ကြည့်။

gandhabba：gandhabba（pu）
ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗ（ပု）
[gamu+tabba．gandha+abba+a．gandha+ava+a]
[ဂမု+တဗ္ဗ။ ဂန္ဓ+အဗ္ဗ+အ။ ဂန္ဓ+အဝ+အ]
C: gandhabba：[m.] 1．a musician； a heavenly musician belonging to the demigods； 2．a being ready to take a new existence.
P:
Gandhabba，[Vedic gandharva] 1．a musician，a singer J.II，249 sq.； III，188； VvA.36，137．-- 2．a Gandharva or heavenly musician，as a class （see °kāyika） belonging to the demigods who inhabit the Cātummahārājika realm D.II，212； A.II，39 （as birds）； IV，200 （with asurā & nāgā），204，207； cp．S.III，250 sq.； also said to preside over child-conception：M.I，265 sq.； Miln.123 sq.

--kāyika belonging to the company of the G．S.III，250 sq.； PvA.119； --mānusā （pl.） G．& men Dh.420= Sn.644； --hatthaka “a G.-hand，” i．e．a wooden instrument in the shape of a bird’s claw with which the body was rubbed in bathing Vin.II，106，see Vin．Texts III，67．（Page 244）
Gandhabbā，（f.） music，song J.II，254； VvA.139； Miln.3； °ṁ karoti to make music J.II，249； III，188．（Page 244）

gandhabba：ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗ（ပု）
[ဂမု+တဗ္ဗ။ ဂန္ဓ+အဗ္ဗ+အ။ ဂန္ဓ+အဝ+အ]
（၁） ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗနတ်။ （၂） ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗမည်သောသူ။ （၃） သဘင်အနုပညာသည်။ （က） ကချေသည်။ （ခ） အဆိုတော်။ （ဂ） စောင်းသမား။ （၄） （က） သီးချင်းသံ။ （ခ） စောင်းသံ။ （၅） သီဆိုခြင်း။ （၆） အနုပညာကျမ်း။ （၇） မြင်း။ （၈） မျောက်။ （၉） （အမိဝမ်းသို့） ကပ်ရောက် လတ္တံ့သော သတ္တဝါ။ （တိ） （၁ဝ） ရောက်အပ်-ရောက်သင့်-ရောက်ထိုက်-သော။ ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗကာယိက-လည်းကြည့်။ ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗဟတ္ထ，ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗဟတ္ထက-ကြည့်။

DOP: 1 gandhabba m. [ S. gandharva], 1. one of a class of heaven-dwelling beings, noted especially as musicians ; Abh 13 (bhūto ca ~o guyhako yakkarakkhasā); 902 (~o devatantare); Vin II 238, 16 (mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatr’ ime bhūtā timi … asurā nāgā ~ā); D III 169, 21 (devā manussā asurā nāgā ~ā); 197, 5* (~ānaṃ ādhipato Dhataraṭṭho); A II 39, 4* (~o vā vihaṅgamo); Dhp 105 (n’ eva devo na ~o na Māro saha brahmunā); Ja IV 252, 20´ (sace devā vā ~ā vā bhaveyyuṃ nacceyyuṃ c’ eva gāyeyyuṃ ca); V 6, 11* (tassa jānanti pitaro ~ā ca sadevakā); VI 265, 5* (ke ~e ca rakkhase; 265, 9´ : ko ~o vā rakkhaso vā); Nidd I 73, 30 (ayaṃ diṭṭhi alaṃ … °-ttāya); Ap 307, 22 (devānaṃ asurānaṃ ca ~ānaṃ ca sakkato); Mil 267, 19 ; Mhv 12:20 (himavante ca ~ā yakkhā); — 2. a musician ; Abh 902 (gāyake … ~o); Th 164 (anaccuṃ tattha ~ā cha sahassāni sattadhā; Th-a II 41, 1 : ~ā ti naṭā); Ja II 254, 24 (mayaṃ mahārāja ~ā nāma sippaṃ nissāya jīvāma, mūlaṃ labhantā vādeyyāmā ti); III 188, 9 (rañño pana Saggo nāma ~o atthi); — 3. a horse ; Abh 902 (asse ~o); — 4. an expression for that impulse or entity which takes (re-)conception ; M I 266, 4 (yato … mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti, mātā ca utunī hoti ~o ca paccupaṭṭhito hoti, evaṃ tiṇṇaṃ sannipātā gabbhassāvakkanti hoti; Ps II 310, 25 foll. : ~o ti tatrūpagasatto … kammayanta-yantito pana eko satto tasmiṃ okāse nibbattanako hotī ti ayaṃ ettha adhippāyo) quoted Mil 123, 11 ; M II 157, 4 (jānanti … bhonto … so ~o khattiyo vā brāhmaṇo vā vesso vā suddo vā ti); Mil 129, 1 (yadi tattha ~o yato kutoci āgantvā aṇḍaje kule uppajjati so tattha aṇḍajo hoti); Sadd 622, 6 (dho tassa gabbhokkamanāsanne satte: ~o ca paccupaṭṭhito hoti); — °- kāyika , mfn. , belonging to the assemblage of the gandhabba s ; S III 250, 13 (santi … mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā … gandhagandhe adhivatthā devā, ime vuccanti … ~ā devā ti); Sv 688, 3 (ayaṃ Cittaseno ~o devaputto); — °- vatika , °-vattika, mfn. , undertaking devotion to the gandhabba s ;? Nidd I 89, 23 (eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā vata-suddhikā … ~ā vā honti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se vatta-suddhikā … °-vattikā); — °- hattha , m. , a wooden instrument for rubbing the body ; Vin-vn 2784 (kāyaṃ ~ena … na ghaṃseyya); — °- hatthaka , m. [ cf S. gandharvahastaka, “the castor-oil tree” ], (according to ct) a wooden instrument for rubbing the body with powder while bathing ; Vin II 106, 7 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ~ena nahāyanti; Sp 1199, 23 : ~enā ti nahānatitthe ṭhapitena dārumayahatthena, tena kira cuṇṇāni gahetvā manussā sarīraṃ ghaṃsanti); — see also gandhabbī.
NCP: masculine one of a class of heavenly beings, noted specially as musicians. an expression for that impulse or entity which takes (re) conception.

[ cf S. gandharvahastaka, “the castor-oil tree” ], (according to ct) a wooden instrument for rubbing the body with powder while bathing ; Vin II 106, 7 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ~ena nahāyanti; Sp 1199, 23 : ~enā ti nahānatitthe ṭhapitena dārumayahatthena, tena kira cuṇṇāni gahetvā manussā sarīraṃ ghaṃsanti); — see also gandhabbī.
NCP: mfn. | gandhabbakaayika belonging to the assembly of the gandhabbas.
